outcome: timely initiation of antenatal care (first quarter of pregnancy)
initiation of antenatal care at 22 weeks or more of gestation
cohort: Brazilian adolescents (<20 years), including those under 13 years old, who had live births between 2020 and 2022, with a focus on victims of sexual violence.
finding: Timely initiation of antenatal care was 70.2% for all adolescents (<20 years) but only 55.6% for those under 13 years old, with 14.1% of adolescents (28.3% among those <13 years old) starting antenatal care at 22 weeks or more of gestation, particularly lower in the North region, among Indigenous girls, and those with low education.
cross-section timing: Data from the Live Births Information System (SINASC) 2020-2022
